thread:
elaine: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a tiny 'handshake-relay' in customer VPCs. purpose: mTLS termination, CSR bootstrap, optional src-ip hinting. keep binary tiny and ops surface minimal.

rahul: define minimal? what state, listeners, and admin surface?

elaine: two ports (mTLS + admin), ephemeral CSR cache, prefix hint cache (small), config via env. no sidecars, no iptables.

marco: src-ip preservation is sticky. options? header-signed hint vs hairpin-egress with allocated egress ips. hairpin = costy.

elaine: exactly. default is signed-src-hint over mTLS; hairpin for contracted customers only. we'll sign hints so downstream can verify.

deploy-bot: deploy:handshake-relay v0.1 canary -> 2 customers at 16:02 UTC

zoe: auth flow? avoid long-lived secrets in VPC.

elaine: CSR flow: customer creates bootstrap token -> relay posts CSR -> CP validates token and issues short cert (TTL small). relays jitter renew.

rahul: fallback path if relay fails?

elaine: chain: local-relay -> regional-relay -> hosted-CP. config-driven. alert if fallback_rate > 5% for 10m.

marco: telemetry: relay.p50_ms, relay.p95_ms, relay.fallback_ratio, cert_renew_errors, src_hint_mode. dashboards will be added.

zoe: rollout plan: canary -> dark traffic -> opt-in beta -> ramp. rollback on >1% 5xx delta or >20ms p50 increase.

elaine: I'll write the RFC follow-up with diagrams and the runbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
